description: High-resolution Multi-purpose Building Electricity Consumption and Weather Dataset, published by Petrík, Filip; Höger, Marek; Bracinik, Peter, records co-located electricity consumption and weather for a multi-purpose building near Žilina. Coverage: One multi-purpose building near Žilina during calendar year 2025. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Both measurement series contain imputed missing values; their different sampling intervals must remain explicit. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
